pricing_discussion_summary: Proposed tiers: Small: 800 GPU-hours/mo; Mid: 2,400 GPU-hours/mo; Large: 6,000 GPU-hours/mo
Burst policy: automatic burst up to 2x baseline for 72 hours monthly; billing model to either draw from pre-purchased burst credits or metered overage.
Overage options discussed: flat $0.12/GPU-hour metered OR capped monthly overage at 20% of committed spend (customer prefers capped).
Ramp schedule requested: months 1-3 at 40% commit credit, months 4-6 at 70%, month 7+ at full commit. Finance wants option to accelerate with discount if commits increased early.
Pilot discount: 30% off committed rate for first 3 months of ramp during formal Dedicated trial (conditional on usage patterns).
SLA ask: 99.5% uptime for Dedicated cluster in region, support response <2 hours P1.
poC_results_summary: Dedicated staging run: 14 days, synthetic traffic + real user sessions. Observed stable p95 latency: chat 140ms (goal 150ms), embeddings p95 70ms.
Cost telemetry: autoscaling + KV cache reduced token-level cost by ~18% compared to hosted baseline under same workload.
Regression: one incident during cold-cache startup; mitigated by warm-up script and recommended KV prefetch.
Security validation: VPC peering test passed; KMS integration demoed with sample key rotation flow.
